style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Prelit Fibre Optic Artificial Christmas Tree With 26 Led Lights
style.toneOfVoice: Bring light and beauty to your home during the most special season with this artificial Christmas tree from HOMCOM. Made using a steady metal base that keeps the tree perfectly upright, it is crafted into a tall design with white and blue life-like branch tips for a beautiful focal point to any room. With a tall and rigid upright branch on the top for placing your angel, this tree is finished with sparkling LED lights all over. Multi-coloured helps create a welcoming and beautiful atmosphere, giving you lots of options to suit your mood and Christmas home furnishings.
